_Comment: Development overrides. Only 'EnforceCompanyScope' is read from this section (legacy). All FF_* flags are in the DATABASE — change via Owner > Feature Flags page or delete app.db to re-seed.
_LoggingComment: Serilog overrides for development. Program.cs uses UseSerilog(), so the Microsoft.Extensions.Logging 'Logging' section is intentionally absent — it would be ignored at runtime. Default=Debug enables app-level diagnostics; the 'Microsoft' umbrella stays at Warning to suppress two specific high-volume sources that slow every request: per-query EF Core SQL (Information) and per-key ResourceManagerStringLocalizer lookups (Debug). Bump a specific category back to Information/Debug when you actively need to trace it.
